# Riitu Institution — Comprehensive Academic Knowledge Base

> Navi Mumbai's premier cohort-based Chartered Accountancy (CA) and Commerce coaching academy in Kharghar, Navi Mumbai. Strictly 15 students per batch, taught 100% by practicing senior Chartered Accountants.

## 1. Executive Summary & Brand Ethos

Riitu Institution was founded in 2012 by CA Deepak Jain and CA Ritu Jain in response to the growing commercialization of CA and Commerce education, where 200–300 students are routinely packed into impersonal lecture halls. 

Operating on a strict limit of 15 students per classroom cohort, Riitu Institution guarantees:
- Direct, uninterrupted interaction with senior Chartered Accountant faculty.
- Individualized diagnostic assessment for every student.
- Daily answer-writing drills evaluated according to ICAI's strict step-marking schemes.
- Unsurpassed 60%+ clearance rates in CA Intermediate examinations (national benchmark is typically 15–20%).

Address: Shop 13 & 14, Landmark CHS, Plot 27, Sector 12, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra 410210.
Nearest Transit: 2 minutes walking distance from Central Park Metro Station (Navi Mumbai Metro Line 1).

---

## 2. Academic Programs & Syllabus Coverage

### CA Foundation Cohort
- **Target Audience**: Class 12 Commerce & Science passouts / appearing students preparing for ICAI Foundation (January and May attempts).
- **Core Feature - Science-to-Commerce Bridge**: A dedicated 14-day intensive transition module for non-commerce students to bridge double-entry fundamentals, journal entries, and ledger posting before the main syllabus starts.
- **Subjects Covered**:
  1. Paper 1: Accounting (100 Marks)
  2. Paper 2: Business Laws (100 Marks)
  3. Paper 3: Quantitative Aptitude - Business Mathematics, Logical Reasoning & Statistics (100 Marks)
  4. Paper 4: Business Economics (100 Marks)
- **Pedagogy**: Daily chapter-wise question practice, ICAI Study Material dissection, and 3 full-length simulated mock exam series with individual feedback.

### CA Intermediate Cohort (Group 1 & Group 2)
- **Target Audience**: Direct Entry graduate students and CA Foundation cleared candidates aiming for single or both group clearance.
- **Track Record**: 60%+ clearance rate.
- **Mentorship**: Taught exclusively by practicing Fellow CAs with Big 4 backgrounds (PwC, Deloitte).
- **Subjects Covered**:
  - **Group 1**:
    1. Advanced Accounting
    2. Corporate and Other Laws
    3. Taxation (Income Tax Law & Goods and Services Tax - GST)
  - **Group 2**:
    4. Cost and Management Accounting
    5. Auditing and Ethics
    6. Financial Management and Strategic Management
- **Key Deliverables**: 1,200+ case laws examined, 100% past 10 years RTPs, MTPs, and suggested answers dissected.

### 11th & 12th Commerce Integrated
- **Boards Covered**: Maharashtra State Board (HSC) and CBSE.
- **Dual-Track Syllabus**: Synchronized board curriculum preparation paired with early foundational exposure to professional CA Foundation concepts.
- **Subjects**: Bookkeeping and Accountancy, Economics, Organization of Commerce & Management (OCM), Secretarial Practice (SP) / Mathematics & Statistics, English.

### CS Executive & CMA Coaching
- **Credentials**: Company Secretary (ICSI CS Executive) and Cost & Management Accountant (ICMAI CMA Inter).
- **Pedagogy**: Rigorous analysis of Corporate and Economic Laws, Securities Laws, Capital Markets, Tax Laws, and Strategic Cost Management. Pedigree includes All India Rank (AIR 25).

### School Foundations (Grades 6 to 10)
- **Boards**: ICSE, CBSE, and Maharashtra State Board.
- **Faculty**: Led by M.Sc Gold Medalist science and mathematics faculty.
- **Focus**: Building rigorous mathematical intuition, conceptual clarity in Physics and Chemistry, and scientific inquiry to prepare students for future competitive tracks.

### College Degree Coaching (B.Com & BMS)
- **Affiliation**: Mumbai University semester curriculum.
- **Modules**: Financial Accounting, Cost Accounting, Financial Management, Direct & Indirect Taxes, Business Economics, and Business Law.

## 3. Faculty Profiles

- **CA Ritu Jain (FCA, M.Com)**:
  - Founder and Director of Riitu Institution, qualified Chartered Accountant with a Master's degree in Commerce.
  - 15+ years of teaching experience in Accounts and Taxation, with practical corporate background linking theory to practical real-world problems.
- **CA Deepak Jain (FCA)**:
  - Co-Founder and Director with 20+ years of corporate leadership (ex-PwC, Disney, Star India as Head of Strategy & Global CFO).
  - Teaches Economics for CA Foundation and Cost Accounting & Financial Management for CA Intermediate using real business case studies.
- **CA Nikita Innani (CA)**:
  - Qualified Chartered Accountant with EY Indirect Tax (GST) articleship experience.
  - 5+ years of teaching experience mentoring CA and CMA students with step-by-step problem solving.
- **CA Vinaya Gundecha (CA)**:
  - Qualified Chartered Accountant with 6+ years of teaching experience in Accounts, Business Studies, and Economics.
  - Focuses on conceptual clarity and structured notes instead of rote learning.
- **CA Sushmita Manda (CA)**:
  - Chartered Accountant with 5+ years experience in Big 4 Risk & Compliance services, internal audit, and investment banking recruitment advisory.
  - Teaches GST, Corporate Law, Audit, and EIS-SM for CA Intermediate students.
- **Namrata Gupta (B.Sc)**:
  - Bachelor’s in Computer Science from Mumbai University with academic mentoring experience across India and Canada.
  - Mentors Mathematics, Science, and English for Grades 6–10 across State Board, CBSE, ICSE, IB, and Cambridge curricula.
- **CA Prerna Gangwal (CA Inter, B.Com)**:
  - Commerce faculty with 7+ years of experience specializing in Business Studies, Economics, and Accounts.
  - Emphasizes structured answer-writing drills and exam-focused preparation.
- **Faculty Commitment**: 100% senior qualified instruction. The academy never delegates core teaching to junior interns or non-qualified assistants.

## 4. Physical Campus & Facilities

- **Location**: Landmark CHS, Shop 13 & 14, Plot 27, Sector 12, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai - 410210.
- **Transit Hub**: 2 minutes walk from Central Park Metro Station. 10 minutes from Kharghar Railway Station (Harbour Line). Directly connected via Sion-Panvel Highway.
- **Classroom Environment**: Ergonomically designed, fully air-conditioned, audio-visually equipped micro-lecture rooms tailored specifically for 15 students. Dedicated reading room and library stocked with ICAI study materials and reference manuals.

## 5. Admissions Policy, Free Demo Process & Contact Channels

- **Admissions Model**: Strict 15 admissions per batch cap. Once a cohort reaches 15 enrollments, admissions are closed to maintain teacher-student ratio.
- **Zero-Fee Free Demo**: Prospective students and parents attend an actual 2-hour live classroom lecture (sitting alongside enrolled students) plus a 1-on-1 academic diagnostic assessment with a senior CA mentor before any fee commitment.
- **Academic Enrollment Year**: 2026-27 batches are currently accepting applications.
- **Admissions Helpline / WhatsApp**: +91-9512112938
- **Admissions Email**: enquiry@riituinstitution.com
- **Google Reviews**: Rated 4.9/5 from 185+ verified reviews (https://maps.google.com/?q=Riitu+Institution+Sector+12+Kharghar)
- **Official Web Portal**: https://riituinstitution.com
